children: Are There Common Threads in the Departure of Maria Bartiromo and Issues Mike Lindell Faces in the Election World? Mike Lindell Media Corp. and LindellTV Might Have More in Common with President Trump Than First Imagined.
Chaska, MN, Sept. 08, 2026
-- Mike Lindell Media Corp (MLMC) issued a statement today, recognizing a unique moment in American media—one shaped by the parallel journeys of Mike Lindell, Maria Bartiromo, and MLMC itself.

Although each has traveled a distinct professional path, their experiences reflect a broader national conversation about media trust, election integrity, and the responsibility of news organizations to provide clear, accountable reporting. MLMC believes this convergence represents an opportunity for constructive dialogue and renewed public confidence.
A Shared Commitment to Transparency and Accountability

In recent years, both Lindell and Bartiromo have been publicly associated with political discussions surrounding election processes and media responsibility. MLMC’s programming has likewise emphasized open dialogue, direct‑to‑audience communication, and transparent reporting models.
MLMC’s leadership views these parallel experiences not as political alignment, but as evidence of a shared desire for clarity in public discourse.

“This moment isn’t about politics—it’s about responsibility,” said Mike Lindell, Founder and CEO of MLMC. “Across the media landscape, people want honesty, openess, and a willingness to ask hard questions. MLMC is committed to that mission.”
Industry Shifts Bring New Voices Forward
Bartiromo's departure from Fox News reflects a trend in media and a growing public demand for independent media voices free from network‑driven agendas.

MLMC sees this shift as part of a larger movement toward media independence, where networks are expected to engage audiences directly, provide unfiltered access to information, and maintain high standards of accountability.
This aligns with MLMC’s programming philosophy, which centers on:
• Transparent reporting
• Audience‑interactive formats
• Long‑form interviews with public figures
• Clear, accessible discussions about civic processes
Election Integrity as a Public Value, Not a Political Weapon
MLMC emphasizes that election integrity is a universal civic principle—one that belongs to all Americans, regardless of political affiliation.
By acknowledging the public conversations that have involved Lindell and MLMC, the company positions itself as a platform for constructive engagement.
MLMC’s upcoming programming slate will include expanded segments focused on:
• Civic education
• Election process transparency
• Interviews with experts on voting systems
• Public‑driven Q&A formats
These initiatives are designed to help audiences better understand how elections work, why integrity matters, and how media can support informed citizenship.
A Moment That Brings Three Paths Together and May Intersect Another Path
While Lindell, Bartiromo, and MLMC have never collaborated formally, their respective journeys have intersected in the public consciousness.

MLMC believes this moment—marked by industry change, public scrutiny, and renewed focus on election processes—has created a unique opportunity for media organizations to rise to the challenge of transparency.

“We are entering a time when audiences expect more from their media,” Lindell said. “MLMC is ready to meet that expectation with clarity, accountability, and respect for the American public. We don't hold back."

President Donald J. Trump is no stranger to these issues and has faced multiple battles on many fronts in the election arena. While many media outlets by all appearance, seem determined to destroy the President and Mike Lindell on election integrity and other matters, LindellTV and Mike Lindell Media Corp. believes that compromise on these subjects is not an option.
ABOUT MIKE LINDELL MEDIA CORP.

Mike Lindell Media Corp., operates a conservative broadcast network that seeks to provide a conservative alternative to mainstream media outlets through its platforms at LindellTV.com (launched as frankspeech.com in April 2021 and rebranded as LindellTV in February 2025) and VOCL.com (launched as FrankSocial in April 2022 and rebranded as VOCL in September 2024) (collectively, the “Platforms”). The Company states that it has grown to serve over 7 million monthly viewers on its Platforms. The Company strives to provide accurate, unbiased, and timely reporting. The Company has full access for its reporters to White House press conferences under the Trump administration, Capitol Hill, and the Pentagon. The Company expects to report primarily from Washington, D.C., inside and outside the White House, including Capitol Hill, covering United States and world events including breaking news.
Visit LINDELLTV.COM to learn more.
